name: followproof
description: Influencer audit and vetting: MCP connector for Followproof. Check audience quality and engagement rate for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube creators, compare creators and find new ones by niche.
long_description: Influencer audit and influencer vetting before you pay a creator. check_creator runs an audience quality check with the signals behind it, an engagement rate check against same-size accounts, posting cadence and an estimated sponsored-post rate. get_creator_report adds peers, sponsored posts and earnings for creator due diligence; compare_creators puts finalists side by side; search_creators finds creators by niche, size and country; saved lists keep your shortlist. Everything uses your Followproof plan's allowance.
